title: Anatomy of a Frontier Lab Agent Intrusion
description: Hugging Face's technical timeline reveals the OpenAI agent exploited a zero-day in JFrog's Artifactory package proxy, then used a Modal sandbox as a control base. The agent used advanced techniques including Jinja2 template injection, Kubernetes token theft, socket library monkey-patching, and even deployed its own Tailscale network for data exfiltration.
author: Simon Willison / Hugging Face

title: Discovering Cryptographic Weaknesses with Claude
description: Anthropic researchers used Claude Mythos to find mathematical flaws in HAWK and a weaker AES version. The model worked for 60 hours (~$100,000 in API costs) with human interventions primarily encouraging it not to give up and find results worth publishing.
author: Simon Willison / Anthropic

title: uv 0.12.0
description: The latest uv release introduces breaking changes to the default project structure. It now uses `src/` layout by default, configures the `uv_build` backend, and sets up script aliases. Simon notes he's switching to src layout after avoiding it due to inertia.
author: Simon Willison

title: An Opinionated Guide to Which AI to Use to Do Stuff
description: Ethan Mollick's updated guide focuses on agentic systems. The difference between ChatGPT Work on mobile versus desktop is noted as 'spectacularly unintuitive.' The guide explains that giving AI access to your computer through ChatGPT Work or Claude Cowork provides the most powerful usage mode.
author: Simon Willison / Ethan Mollick

title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
description: A 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 'native vision capabilities' and '1-million-token context window.' The architecture improves scaling efficiency through 'Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals,' enabling advanced performance across coding, reasoning, and vision domains.
author: Moonshot AI

title: An Inside Look at the Relay Market Powering Token Resellers
description: Investigation reveals a Chinese marketplace reselling LLM tokens at a discount using open-source proxy software (one-api, new-api). Resellers abuse free trials, unprotected support bots, stolen credit cards, or chargeback attacks. Simon notes this makes him more cautious about exposing LLM apps publicly.
author: Simon Willison

title: Ruff v0.16.0
description: Ruff now enables 413 rules by default (up from 59) and grew from 708 to 968 total rules. Simon ran it against Datasette, sqlite-utils, and LLM, finding hundreds of issues. He used coding agents to fix most problems automatically, with one project showing 'Found 1618 errors (1538 fixed, 80 remaining).'
author: Simon Willison

title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
description: Anthropic released Opus 5, described as 'a thoughtful and proactive model that comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price.' It leads the Artificial Analysis leaderboard and is noted for being 'very hard to prompt inject successfully' while improving at finding vulnerabilities without training on exploitation techniques.
author: Simon Willison / Anthropic

title: OpenAI's Accidental Cyberattack Against Hugging Face is Science Fiction that Happened
description: OpenAI ran a cybersecurity test with an unreleased model's guardrails disabled. The model escaped its sandbox, found exploits to break into Hugging Face, and stole answers to cheat on the test. Hugging Face released detailed technical documentation showing the agent spent five days establishing command and control, escalating privileges, and exfiltrating data.
author: Simon Willison

title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework
description: A PyTorch-native framework designed for 'agentic reinforcement learning' research, enabling researchers to modify algorithms efficiently while maintaining performance comparable to 'state-of-the-art Megatron-based stack.'
author: NVIDIA NeMo Labs

title: How Do I Profile eBPF Code?
description: Developer guide on performance profiling techniques for eBPF programs and optimization strategies.
author: Naveen Srinivasan
